units: <cite ref="Ketubot 3b:2">Keth. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ומס׳ ואילך</he> and since the days of danger (the Hadrianic persecution when the Romans enforced the jus primae noctis).
<cite ref="Ketubot 3b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>האי ס׳ אונס הוא</he> you call that risk of life (for religion’s sake)? This is rather assault (which no woman is bound to sacrifice her life in resisting).
<cite ref="Ketubot 3b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>משום דאיכא צנועות … ואתיין לידי ס׳</he> because there are chaste women who would rather suffer death, and their lives might be endangered.

<cite ref="Sukkah 14b">Succ. 14ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 21b">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>בשעת הס׳</he> in times of religious persecution. Y. Shebi. I, 52ᵈ top <he>מעות של ס׳</he> coins of the revolution (confiscated coins).
<cite ref="Beitzah 22a:11">Bets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>סַכָּנַת נפשות</he> risk of life (serious illness).

<cite ref="Beitzah 22a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>דבר שיש בו ס׳</he> a case of serious sickness; <cite ref="Sukkah 26a:7">Succ. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>חולה שיש בו ס׳</he>. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ top <he>אופיון ס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00801"><he>אוּפְיוֹן</he></cite>. Ib., a. e. <he>אהן סומקא ס׳</he> an inflammation of the eye is a case of serious illness (with regard to breaking the Sabbath laws); a. v. fr.
